body:
This is somewhat expected as there can only be one type of refinement per attribute. What you could do if the preset is an absolute is use `useRange` and set the minimum and maximum to the number you want to explicitly refine. Then the list will cooperate with a separate range widget.

https://codesandbox.io/p/sandbox/festive-nova-j4qd6v?file=%2Fsrc%2FPresets.tsx%3A43%2C47
